output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balances of an arbitrary user to any value.
The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows any user to transfer any balance between any accounts.
The 'approve' function allows the owner to set the allowance to zero, but it also keeps in the old value when zero is requested.
The 'getStats' function uses block.timestamp and block.coinbase as a source of randomness, which is predictable and unsafe.
The constructor is misspelled as 'master' instead of 'mastermind'. This leads to loss of funds in the only created instance.
